race.description: John Archibald 10 Year Memorial Midway Mdn Plate
race.comment: ATEBA (3) has not raced since finishing third as a $1.40 chance on debut over 1000m at this track 18 weeks ago. A heavy track possibly contributed to that surprise defeat. Won a recent trial by a huge space so he looks ready to put the record straight. MAGIC BLAZE (2) stalked the leaders then let down impressively but was beaten a lip when resuming over 1000m at Kembla last start. Promising four-year-old who will be a significant force over the extra 200m today. DIAMOND DICE (9) has been in the money at both runs this prep, albeit in country maidens. Honest filly who should be competitive again with the blinkers going back on. ARTFULL (1) has been handy into the straight at all four runs this campaign but lacks a turn of foot when it counts. Gets a couple of gear changes today which may improve things.
